title: Sections of abelian sheaves preserve directed colimits on compact opens
statement: Let X be a topological space whose compact open subsets form a basis and whose compact opens are closed under binary intersections. Let I be a nonempty directed preorder. For every compact open U, the section functor Gamma(U,-) from abelian sheaves on the open site of X to abelian groups preserves colimits of shape I. Sections and the open site are as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].

proof.text: Use preservation of colimits by the abelian sheaf stalk functor, Mathlib Concrete.isColimit_rep_eq_iff_exists, and the germ equality criterion. Equality of two colimit sections is locally equality at a common stage.

Compactness replaces these local equalities by finitely many neighborhoods. Directedness gives one common stage for the neighborhoods, and sheaf separation gives equality over the whole compact open. This proves injectivity of the canonical section comparison.

Every colimit section locally lifts to a stage, using Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep on the stalk colimit and the germ representation theorem. Refine the local covering to a finite covering by compact opens, using the compact-open basis and compactness.

Choose one upper stage for finitely many lifts. Their images agree on each compact pairwise overlap, so the preceding eventual equality gives another common stage where all overlaps agree. Glue there, and use separation to identify its image with the original section. The canonical comparison is bijective, hence an isomorphism in AddCommGrpCat. Apply preservesColimit_of_isIso_post and quantify over diagrams.

theorem abelianSections_preservesDirectedColimits
    (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X]
    (hbas : ∀ (V : Set X), IsOpen V → ∀ x ∈ V, ∃ W : Set X, IsOpen W ∧
      IsCompact W ∧ x ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ V)
    (hint : ∀ (V W : Set X), IsOpen V → IsOpen W → IsCompact V → IsCompact W →
      IsCompact (V ∩ W))
    (I : Type u) [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (U : Opens X) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape I
      ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op U))
